scope: Pants assembly regression and mobile control obstruction

findings.problem: 262 removed the whole bare legs to prevent clipping, leaving hollow cuffs.
findings.fix: Restore two closed legs in each pants base; smoothly fit covered cross-sections beneath the fabric while retaining the original rounded lower ends. Shorts/skirt/bikini bases and all pants fabric remain unchanged.
findings.evidence: All tops with pants, eight angles; enlarged cuff/underside checks; six closed leg meshes and 16416 surface-clearance samples with no penetration.

findings.problem: The mobile sticky preview covered the clothing selectors, intercepting taps. Programmatic selectOption testing missed this.
findings.fix: Mobile preview now participates in normal page flow, leaving clothing controls unobstructed.
findings.evidence: Pointer-access and actual native-select re-selection at 320/390px, landscape844x390 and desktop1400x1000; both builds, all bottom transitions.

findings.problem: The diagnostic ready flag could report an old model after a failed new selection.
findings.fix: Ready now requires the current selection generation to have rendered successfully; expose the committed selection for verification.
findings.evidence: Actual rendered base checked after outfit/build changes, rapid switching and reload; compare262 retains the previous empty-cuff model.

visual_passes: Exported component assembly: 134 views covering every top with pants, eight angles, enlarged hems and other bottoms.
Reimported final assembled GLBs: 16 views across both builds and all eight angles; inspected front, sides, back and underside.
process_correction: Acceptance requires visible complete anatomy and correct drape, not merely absence of clipping nodes. UI tests must use hit testing and actual pointer/keyboard interaction, not only setting select values.
owner_status: Correction awaiting owner review; no broad production qualification claimed.
